rules.text: peel leading ال then single-letter proclitics from clitic_inventory; a peel that leaves <2 letters is invalid (abstain false_stem_risk)

letter ownership REQUIRES supplied root_evidence (root radicals + basis). A letter is root iff it matches the next expected radical in order; an initial م is pattern_augment ONLY when root_evidence exists and م is not the expected radical. NO root_evidence -> abstain no_root_evidence. (repairs own-r2-v1; guard og-2/og-6)
an inflection prefix from inflection_prefixes may be assigned only when token_kind=verb_imperfect is declared AND the letter is not the expected radical
any letter left unowned, or owned twice, forces abstain pending_letter_ownership for the WHOLE token
weak roots: a radical absent from the surface is recorded as hidden_radical, never forced onto a surface letter
